root_cause: SliverFadeTransition was constructed only from an OpacityController, so a DoubleAnimation could not drive it (Flutter takes Animation<double>).
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/sliver_fade.rs: SliverFadeTransition holds a FadeSource (Controller | Animation); new from_animation(impl Into<DoubleAnimation>, sliver). Animation path builds via FadeTransition::from_animation and uses AnimatedFadeRenderSliver, which ticks the animation's controllers on each frame and lays children out with Opacity::new(clamped value). Controller constructor and path unchanged.
harness: transitions__sliver_fade__opacity: match (3 frames). Scenario twin unchanged (it uses the controller constructor).
limitations: none known; the scenario does not exercise the animation constructor.
note: Clamping to 0..=1 happens in the render sliver, as in Flutter's Opacity layer.

root_cause: Transform paints its child as vector display commands (PaintCommand::PushTransform) and the compositor layer (LayerKind::Transform) carries only a matrix. Neither has a sampling field, so there is no point where a filter quality could take effect. Flutter's Transform(filterQuality) wraps the child in ImageFilter.matrix, which resamples the child layer.
change: none. No descriptor field was added: a stored option that nothing applies would be a dead API.
harness: transitions__paint__decoration_matrix: match (6 frames). The recorder cannot observe sampling, so the scenario does not show the gap.
limitations: Blocked on renderer work outside this group: add a sampling field to PaintCommand::PushTransform and LayerKind::Transform (incular-rendering), thread it through WidgetKind/RenderKind::Transform (tree/widget/constructors.rs, tree/rendering/lowering/effects.rs, tree/painting.rs), and apply it in incular-wgpu when a transformed layer is resampled. Then add filter_quality to the Transform descriptor and to MatrixTransition/ScaleTransition/RotationTransition.
note: Needs an owner for incular-rendering and incular-wgpu; not in this worker's file list.

root_cause: DecoratedBoxTransition accepted only TweenAnimation<BoxDecoration>; ShapeDecoration could not be animated.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/animation_transitions.rs: new Decoration enum (Box | Shape) with Lerp: same kind interpolates (box via BoxDecoration::lerp, shape via lerp_shape_decoration, color via OptionalColorTween, shadows via BoxShadow::lerp_list); mixed kinds switch at t<0.5. DecoratedBoxTransition::new takes impl Into<TweenAnimation<Decoration>>; From impls for TweenAnimation<BoxDecoration> and TweenAnimation<ShapeDecoration> keep existing callers compiling. Shape decorations build through DecoratedShapeBox. lib.rs exports Decoration.
api_change: additive plus signature widening: DecoratedBoxTransition::new(impl Into<TweenAnimation<Decoration>>, child). Existing TweenAnimation<BoxDecoration> arguments still compile; no other workspace caller changed (facade test checked).
limitations: ShapeDecoration lerp switches gradient, image and shape at the midpoint, because Incular's ShapeBorder has no lerp (Flutter lerps them). DecorationPosition::Foreground applies to box decorations only; shape decorations paint behind the child.
note: Mixed-kind switch follows the brief's t<0.5 rule.

root_cause: AnimatedAlign, AnimatedPadding, AnimatedContainer and AnimatedFractionallySizedBox stored physical Alignment/EdgeInsets only, so directional geometry could not be given.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/implicit_animations.rs: new AlignmentGeometry and EdgeInsetsGeometry enums (Physical | Directional) with resolve(TextDirection) and From impls. TweenPass now carries the ambient direction (set in ImplicitState::update from the build context); each for_each_tween resolves its directional targets with it. Build fallbacks resolve with context.text_direction(), defaulting to Ltr. Setters take impl Into<...>; existing physical callers compile unchanged. lib.rs exports both types.
api_change: additive: setters on AnimatedAlign::new, AnimatedPadding::new, AnimatedContainer alignment/padding/margin/transform_alignment and AnimatedFractionallySizedBox::alignment accept impl Into<AlignmentGeometry|EdgeInsetsGeometry>. Physical callers are unaffected.
limitations: A text-direction change after a target was set is not re-resolved until the next target change (Flutter re-resolves each frame). AnimatedPositionedDirectional already resolved per build and is unchanged.
note: The 'Directional' variants keep Flutter's type-preserving lerp only at the resolved level; mixed endpoints resolve before interpolating, which is the same result for a fixed direction.

root_cause: Color, Size and Rect tween endpoints were non-optional, so Flutter's null-endpoint lerp semantics could not be expressed.
change: crates/incular-animation/src/tween.rs: NullableTween trait (absent_like: transparent same-RGB color, zero size, zero rect), OptionalTween<T> with lerp/evaluate (both absent -> None; one absent scales the present end), aliases OptionalColorTween/OptionalSizeTween/OptionalRectTween; Tween impl for Rect (origin and size interpolate unclamped). lib.rs exports the new names. The existing TweenValue aliases are unchanged.
api_change: additive: NullableTween, OptionalTween, OptionalColorTween, OptionalSizeTween, OptionalRectTween; Tween for Rect.
limitations: Rect nullable semantics follow Rect.lerp per side with the origin/size form. Nothing in Incular consumes the optional tweens yet.
note: Expected values cited from Flutter painting.dart:415-437 and tween.dart:401-470 as the finding does.
